description: This file contains the implementation of an SMTP client class in PHP, which provides functions to connect to an SMTP server, authenticate, send emails, and execute related SMTP commands. It's designed to facilitate sending emails through SMTP protocol within a PHP application.

classes.name: SMTP
classes.description: A class providing SMTP protocol functionalities such as connecting, authenticating, sending mail data, and executing SMTP commands.

methods.name: Connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the specified SMTP server.

methods.name: Authenticate
methods.description: Performs SMTP authentication with username and password.

methods.name: Data
methods.description: Sends email message data to the SMTP server.

methods.name: Expand
methods.description: Expands a mailing list or address group into individual addresses.

methods.name: Hello
methods.description: Sends HELO or EHLO command to initialize SMTP communication.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Initiates the sending process from a specified email address.

methods.name: Recipient
methods.description: Adds a recipient email address for the message.

methods.name: Verify
methods.description: Verifies if a server recognizes a given email address or hostname.
